description: This file defines an interface IPasswordHasher for password hashing within the Conduit.Infrastructure.Security namespace, including a method to asynchronously hash passwords with salt.

classes.name: IPasswordHasher
classes.description: Interface for hashing passwords, implementing IDisposable, with a method for hashing a password with a salt asynchronously.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Asynchronously hashes a password given the password string and salt byte array.
